album: IT'S NICE TO SEE A LAKE IN YOUR EYES
excerpt: The debut partnership of Carol Maia and Jeremy Gustin has delivered an album of rare alchemy. With thousands of miles between Carol's home in Rio de Janeiro and Jeremy's in Brooklyn and with the help of a few friends from their respective cities they have created a record that is intimate, quietly funky and transcendental in its poetic beauty.
Afro-Cuban rhythms, no-wave garage punk edge, homemade funk and a fearless middle-fingered attitude towards generic straightforwardness. It's also fun, surreal, irreverent and ace.
